name: Alpenware AG
description: Precision-engineered software solutions for a connected world.
story: Alpenware AG, a leading Swiss software company, sees motorsport as the ultimate testing ground for its real-time data analytics and predictive algorithms. With a focus on innovation and precision, they seek a partnership to demonstrate the power of their technology in a high-performance environment. They are looking to enhance brand awareness and showcase their capabilities to a global audience.
